description: This file defines the internal sealed class StringValuesValue, which extends FluidValue, providing functionality for handling string collections within the Fluid templating engine, including comparison, conversion, and async writing methods.

classes.name: StringValuesValue
classes.description: A sealed class extending FluidValue, encapsulating StringValues and providing templating functionalities.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides equality comparison for FluidValue objects, including deep comparison with StringValues and ArrayValue.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a FluidValue is contained within the StringValues collection.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on the internal StringValues.

methods.name: GetValueAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves special properties like size, first, and last of the StringValues collection.

methods.name: GetIndex
methods.description: Obsolete method for index access, replaced by GetIndexAsync.

methods.name: GetIndexAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous index access method, for backward compatibility.

methods.name: ToBooleanValue
methods.description: Converts the StringValues to a boolean, always true.

methods.name: ToNumberValue
methods.description: Converts the StringValues count to a decimal number.

methods.name: ToObjectValue
methods.description: Converts StringValues to a single string or array, or null if empty.

methods.name: ToStringValue
methods.description: Concatenates StringValues into a single string.

methods.name: Values
methods.description: Returns the StringValues as a list of StringValue objects.

methods.name: Enumerate
methods.description: Provides an enumeration of the StringValues as FluidValues.

methods.name: WriteTo
methods.description: Obsolete method for writing StringValues to a TextWriter synchronously.

methods.name: WriteToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes StringValues to a TextWriter.
